title: Ghost holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ecb'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#f0509a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c22a75'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='ghostGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f4f7ff'/>
      <stop offset='75%' stop-color='#cdd8f2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9fb0da'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M60 47 C58 56 62 62 57 70' fill='none' stroke='#8fd6ff' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='33' rx='16' ry='18' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <path d='M58 50 L61 47 L64 50 Z' fill='#c22a75'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='25' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#ffd3e8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- ghost body -->
  <path d='M32 82 L32 56 C32 40 42 32 52 32 C62 32 72 40 72 56 L72 82
           L66 75 L60 82 L54 75 L48 82 L42 75 L36 82 Z'
        fill='url(#ghostGrad)'/>
  <!-- ghost wavy shading on body edge -->
  <path d='M68 56 C70 62 70 70 69 80 L72 82 L72 56 C72 48 69 42 64 38 C68 44 68 50 68 56 Z'
        fill='#9fb0da' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='55' rx='4.6' ry='6' fill='#3b2e6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='55' rx='4.6' ry='6' fill='#3b2e6b'/>
  <circle cx='46.4' cy='53' r='1.6' fill='#b9e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='60.4' cy='53' r='1.6' fill='#b9e6ff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='65' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ffb3d1' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='65' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ffb3d1' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M48 66 Q52 70 56 66' fill='none' stroke='#3b2e6b' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ghost arm reaching to hold string -->
  <path d='M70 60 C74 62 74 66 71 69' fill='none' stroke='#cdd8f2' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='69.5' r='3.4' fill='#e4eafb'/>
</svg>
